ops.reason: Its app was deleted in this change set (decision tui-delete-old-apps); the CLI commands it wrapped stay

set.acceptance: A testscript: rhiza run start <cs> queues the run and prints that it waits for the daemon; rhiza daemon --once then starts it headless, or leaves it queued while maxRuns runs are live; a run queued on an accepted backlog change set and a plan run queued on a draft change set are both started by rhiza daemon --once; rhiza run start --foreground drives the run in the calling process
set.statement: rhiza run start queues the run for the daemon, which starts it headless within maxRuns, instead of driving it in the caller's tab; a queued run is the owner's start, not a daemon pick, so the daemon starts it on whatever change set rhiza run start accepts (backlog change sets and plan runs on drafts included) without daemon-picks' milestone, state and leaf filters; with no daemon running it says the run waits for one; rhiza run start --foreground drives the run in place, for debugging and as the daemon's own child

set.acceptance: plan-requests.txtar with a fake rex: request queues an item shown queued by request ls; daemon --once starts run start --workflow plan --new with the request's text (a bug's prefixed "Fix ", so its title names the bug, a milestone's with --milestone), --autonomous only with plan auto and never for a milestone request, and request ls then shows planning with the run; when the run's journal names the planned change set, request ls shows planned with it; paused starts nothing; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
change show on a change set that updates a statement prints a Changes section with the old and new statement
set.statement: rhiza change show ends with a Changes section holding the change set's field-level diff

set.acceptance: feed.txtar: by default an actor-only record is hidden while a planning record and an intention are shown, and with --all all three are shown; with --limit the pages are full and the next-page line carries --all; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
set.statement: rhiza feed leaves out landed change sets whose ops only create or update actor nodes unless --all is given, filtering before paging so pages stay full and cursors stable

set.acceptance: make -n test shows go test ./... with -skip of TestReadBudget|TestBudget|TestGeneratedModel, then those tests alone with -p 1 over internal/api, internal/index and internal/slice; the budget phase passes on the loaded VM where it failed beside the suite; CI's make check passes
